decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk builds directly on the firm's established office furniture know-how, so management can read market feedback and keep refining the system.
A chair family sits in the firm's core seating and upholstery competence, where its existing knowledge best supports learning and improvement.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche product on the edge of the firm's knowledge base and are harder to evaluate, but they reuse material from the rug line at low cost and fit the home-collection offer.
The upholstered sofa from a long-standing design partner draws on the firm's deepest upholstery expertise and was presented prominently as a new highlight in 2019.
A high standing table fits the firm's office and conference table competence and complements its desk systems, so it can be assimilated and adapted easily.
The rug collection extends an existing textile line that complements the firm's living collections, giving it enough related knowledge to interpret results and keep developing it.
